purpose: one-shot process-exit recovery for the approved isolated local run
label: com.coscientist.local-live195.guardian
observed_state: running and waiting for the original API process to exit; original API health returned 200
behavior: Watches the original API PID without provider calls. If it exits, launches the same isolated stack and SQLite store once. Does not create a new research run.
cleanup: After the run is terminal and evidence is saved, use launchctl bootout gui/<current-user-id>/com.coscientist.local-live195.guardian, then stop the isolated stack and remove its temporary files after confirming no work remains.
limitations: A restart may retry the currently leased task under the existing durable recovery policy.
The guardian has KeepAlive=false; a second crash requires deliberate diagnosis rather than an automatic loop.
The guardian does not establish local-run or report acceptance.
